title: KisakCOD capability and evidence manifest
description: Small authoritative dataset behind docs/CAPABILITY_DASHBOARD.md. Capability rows describe production delivery; supporting_evidence rows describe utility, test-artifact, scaffold and instrument evidence that must never advance a production row. Issue #126 (A04) owns this manifest.

supporting_evidence.label: Windows x86 MP/SP/dedicated shared-object and stamp parity gate

evidence.note: The M0 gate compares the shared buildnumber.cpp reference object's retail sections and buildnumber agreement across MP/SP/dedicated with CodeView metadata excluded. It is not whole-engine equivalence and not original-peer interoperability.
Reproducible-build helpers establish same-profile determinism only. They do not establish wire equality or command-driven whole-engine simulation parity.
Envelope and self-test evidence is not M5 graph parity. The instrument must be enrolled in real walkers over licensed assets before it counts as actual graph capture.
The reviewed wire test links no MSG implementation, so it cannot establish wire equality. Production serializer fixtures against commercial references remain open in #127.
Recorded-state playback is not simulation fidelity. A fixed-tick usercmd-driven comparison against both commercial references is required (#127) and not yet built.
Manual-only and deferred: no self-hosted [kisakcod, windows, x86] runner is registered and KISAKCOD_GAME_DIR is unset. Do not dispatch it.
CoD4x is a patched community client, not the Steam commercial 1.8 reference, and cannot satisfy either required commercial profile.
